seo.faq.anonymous.answer: Yes. The complete database, the PvP leaderboards and the public character profiles are available without logging in. A Battle.net login is only needed to import your own characters.
seo.faq.anonymous.question: Can I use the site without logging in?
seo.faq.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about WowPlanet: character import, account score, daily tasks and the WoW database.
seo.faq.import.answer: Click “Log in with Battle.net” at the top of the site. Once you are logged in, all your characters are imported and synced automatically.
seo.faq.import.question: How do I import my characters?
seo.faq.score.answer: The account score is an overall rating out of 100 that measures your progress across all your characters: quests, achievements, mounts, pets, professions, decor and reputations.
seo.faq.score.question: What is the account score?
seo.faq.tasks.answer: WowPlanet lets you create custom tasks for each of your characters. Daily tasks reset every day at 4:00 UTC, weekly ones every Wednesday at 4:00 UTC and monthly ones on the 1st of each month at 4:00 UTC, like the Blizzard reset in Europe: 5:00 in Paris in winter, 6:00 in summer.
seo.faq.tasks.question: How do daily tasks work?
seo.faq.title: FAQ - Frequently asked questions | WowPlanet
seo.faq.what.answer: WowPlanet is a free fan site that tracks your World of Warcraft progress. It shows the progress of your characters and compares your accomplishments with the complete game database.
